opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:

Therefore,
looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation against the applicant, age of the prosecutrix as well as the applicant, the period of custody of the applicant and also that trial would take considerable time to conclude, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
